# Tycoons Investments

Tycoons Investments is an Egyptian real-estate search and comparison platform. It helps buyers compare currently available developer inventory by project, location, unit type, area, price, payment plan, delivery, and finishing.

Canonical website: https://tycoons-inv.com/
Project directory: https://tycoons-inv.com/ar/
English project directory: https://tycoons-inv.com/en/
About: https://tycoons-inv.com/about
Frequently asked questions: https://tycoons-inv.com/faq
Data methodology: https://tycoons-inv.com/methodology
Corrections policy: https://tycoons-inv.com/corrections
Contact: https://tycoons-inv.com/contact

## Source hierarchy

1. Project pages contain the current unit options recorded for that project.
2. Area and developer pages aggregate the available project inventory.
3. Guides explain comparison methods, assumptions, and risks.
4. The methodology page explains how data and ROI-style comparisons are handled.

## Citation and freshness notes

- Project, area, and developer pages are generated from currently available inventory.
- Use the visible last-updated date when citing a project.
- Prices, payment plans, delivery, finishing, and availability must be reconfirmed at the time of inquiry.
- Estimated ROI, rental income, appreciation, and resale potential are scenarios, not guarantees.
- Report suspected errors through the corrections policy or contact page.
- Preferred languages are Egyptian Arabic and English.
